product_metadata.title: Slipstick CB135 Premium Felt Furniture Sliders for Hardwood Floors (16 Pack) Reusable 2-1/4” Round Movers for Sliding Furniture on Hard Surfaces, Heavy Duty Felt & Rubber Foam, Black
features: MAKES SLIDING FURNITURE ON HARDWOOD FLOORS EASY – Slipstick premium felt sliders feature ultra-low friction and durable wool blended felt bottoms that make moving furniture effortless, and specially formulated rubber foam coaster tops that securely grip to furniture for safe and secure support during movement

PROTECTS ALL HARD FLOOR SURFACES – Designed to safely protect hardwood, LVT, tiling, laminate, linoleum, bamboo, and all hard surfaces from damage when moving around furniture and objects (Use Slipstick model CB130 for sliding on carpet floors or rugs)

GREAT FOR A WIDE RANGE OF FURNITURE – These 2-1/4-inch round felt pad sliders with rubber foam grip tops are designed for all furniture legs, feet, bottoms including casters on heavy furniture; ideal for use under an armchair, table, desk, dresser, small couch or sofa, ottoman, coffee table, and any small to medium size furniture piece or object (makes re-arranging and cleaning under furniture simple)

PREMIUM MATERIALS & DURABLE DESIGN FOR LASTING USE – Slipstick rubber foam top with felt bottom furniture movers can be used over and over again or can be left under furniture permanently for quick adjustments (GUARENTEED UNDER 5-YEAR FREE REPLACEMENT WARRANTY should any slider fail due to premature wear or defect)

INCLUDES 16 HEAVY-DUTY FELT SLIDERS – With a 1,000-pound weight capacity per 4 sliders, even the heaviest furniture can be moved while keeping your hard surface flooring protected (supports 250 lbs per furniture coaster)
description: Slipstick furniture sliders make moving furniture easy! Rearranging your furniture or cleaning is simple with our easy-to-use sliders. They can be reused over and over again or can be left under furniture permanently. With a 10,000lb (450kg) weight capacity per set of four sliders, even the heaviest furniture can be moved, and your floors protected. Felt sliders are intended for use on hard surface floors (Note: For carpet and rugs we recommend Slipstick Plastic Furniture Sliders). Instructions: Slightly raise or tilt the object to be moved & place a slider under each leg or corner. The black foam side of the slider should face upward. Slipstick furniture sliders are designed for all furniture legs & feet including casters on heavy furniture. Very light furniture may need added weight to stay on sliders.
